# Task Playbook Scenarios

## Feature

Request: add a visible export action. Facts: `new-user-outcome`.
Reference: `../../references/task-playbook-contract.md#feature-playbook`.

## Bug Fix

Request: repair an incorrect total. Facts: `reproduced-defect`.
Reference: `../../references/task-playbook-contract.md#bug-fix-playbook`.

## Refactor

Request: simplify the parser without changing behavior. Facts: `behavior-preserving`.
Reference: `../../references/task-playbook-contract.md#refactor-playbook`.

## Performance

Request: reduce report latency. Facts: `repeatable-performance-baseline`.
Reference: `../../references/task-playbook-contract.md#performance-playbook`.

## Skill Change

Request: revise a skill instruction. Facts: `skill-instruction-change`.
Reference: `../../references/task-playbook-contract.md#skill-change-playbook`.

## Workflow Eval

Request: compare two workflow outputs. Facts: `standalone-evaluation`.
Reference: `../../references/task-playbook-contract.md#workflow-eval-playbook`.

## Generic

Request: update a narrowly scoped internal default. Facts: none.
Reference: `../../references/task-playbook-contract.md#generic-playbook`.

## Ambiguous

Request: make exports better. Facts: none; use Generic until evidence resolves a controlling route.
